lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.title: Lukmanier · Oberalp · Vorderrhein High Roads · part 1
lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.slogan: Chur fuel to Andermatt base · one way

waypoints.name: Chur fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Chur is where the day begins. Next is Lukmanier pass road, climbing 1322 m.

waypoints.name: Lukmanier pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 1915 m here. The road climbs 1322 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 9 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Andermatt, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Andermatt base reset
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 182 km. You lose 471 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind.

sections.advice: Chur fuel gate → Lukmanier pass road climbs about 1322 m in 80 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lukmanier pass road → Andermatt base reset drops about 471 m over 22 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Chur fuel gate → Lukmanier pass road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 143 km. 1322 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1915 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.story: 182 km one way from Chur - plan on about 3 h 29 of riding. Lukmanier pass road is the high point. It tops out at 1,915 m. Lukmanier Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Cemetery in Encarnación de Díaz → Historic centre of the city of Lagos
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-historic-ensemble-of-the-city-of-.story: 207 km from Aguascalientes to Aguascalientes, about 3 h 34 of riding. The stops in between: Former hacienda of Peñuelas, Cemetery in Encarnación de Díaz, Historic centre of the city of Lagos de Mo and back through Cemetery in Encarnación de Díaz. The highest point is about 2,150 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-ethiopia-bale-mountains-road.story: curated scenic road. Afro-alpine plateau, forest, wildlife. 184 km from Shashemenē to the finish, about 3 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: Dodola and Ethiopia Bale Mountains Road. The highest point is about 4,000 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Ethiopia Bale Mountains Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Ethiopia Bale Mountains Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
